Then $\lambda_f(1) = a_f(1)$, the coefficient of $e^{2\pi i z}$ in the $q$-expansion of $f$.
nodes.title: Normalized cusp form coefficient at one

nodes.summary: Let $f$ be a cusp form of weight $k \in \mathbb{Z}$ for $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$, with $q$-expansion $f(z) = \sum_{n \ge 0} a_f(n) e(nz)$, where $e(z) = e^{2\pi i z}$. For each natural number $n$, the normalized Fourier coefficient of $f$ is the complex number $\lambda_f(n) = a_f(n) / n^{(k-1)/2}$, where $n^{(k-1)/2}$ is the real power.
nodes.title: Normalized Fourier coefficients of a cusp form

nodes.title: Normalized Hecke eigenform

nodes.summary: Let $f$ be a normalized Hecke eigenform of weight $k \in \mathbb{Z}$ for $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$, with normalized Fourier coefficients $\lambda_f$. Then $\lambda_f(p)^2 = \lambda_f(p^2) + 1$ for every prime $p$.
nodes.title: Hecke relation at the square of a prime

nodes.summary: Let $f$ be a cusp form of weight $k \in \mathbb{Z}$ for $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$, with normalized Fourier coefficients $\lambda_f$ and Rankin–Selberg coefficients $\lambda_{f \times f}$. For every natural number $n$, $\lambda_{f \times f}(n) = \sum_d \lambda_f(n/d)^2$, where $d$ runs over the positive divisors of $n$ that are perfect squares (so the sum is empty when $n = 0$).
nodes.title: Rankin–Selberg coefficients as a sum over square divisors

nodes.summary: Let $f$ be a cusp form of weight $k \in \mathbb{Z}$ for $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$, with normalized Fourier coefficients $\lambda_f$ and Rankin–Selberg coefficients $\lambda_{f \times f}$. Then $\lambda_{f \times f}(1) = \lambda_f(1)^2$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
